nodes.name: Check recipient and write review email

parameters.jsCode:
const allow = String($vars.HARVESTNET_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST || '').split(',').map(a => a.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean); const recipient = (value) => { const to = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().toLowerCase() : ''; if (!allow.length || !allow.includes(to)) throw new Error('Recipient is not on HARVESTNET_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST'); return to; }; const b = $json.body || {}; const to = recipient(b.to); const base = String($vars.HARVESTNET_REVIEW_BASE_URL || '').replace(//+$/, '') + '/human/review?token='; const url = typeof b.decision_url === 'string' ? b.decision_url : ''; if (!base.startsWith('https://') || !url.startsWith(base) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,128}$/.test(url.slice(base.length))) throw new Error('A review link issued by HarvestNet is required'); if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,40}$/.test(String(b.organization_id || '')) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,100}$/.test(String(b.lot_id || '')) || !Number.isInteger(b.version) || b.version < 1 || !/^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(String(b.terms_hash || ''))) throw new Error('Issued human review request required'); const subject = 'HarvestNet: review draft version ' + b.version + ' for lot ' + b.lot_id; const message = 'HarvestNet: ' + b.organization_id + ', review draft version ' + b.version + ' for lot ' + b.lot_id + '.

' + 'Open the link to see the exact terms (terms hash ' + b.terms_hash + ') and choose Approve or Decline:
' + url + '

No reply means no approval.'; return [{json: {to, subject, message}}];
